p04.label: Main battlefield

evidence.quote: DM: As the energy of the Heartroot washes over you, you gather on the back of the silver dragon Kenzo and fly… the short distance to the battle still raging. At the moment… the Hobgoblins seem to have… solidified their position and established a solid defensive line, having driven many of the hippos off. And the rangers are beginning to fall back when… a dragon just flies right through the illusory mountain, and… immediately swoops down on the Hobgoblin troops with a… massive line of cold that rips through their defenses and… breaks a hole in the front of the line, as the Rangers and lizardfolk and Aurbezi militias and… folks still remaining as… as hippos, and Vindristjarna, where… Faldrak, despite taking some damage, has managed to defeat the metallic birds that you left. With great help from Hektor and a few others. They all probably gained a level from this.

p04.note: Nearby main battlefield; its precise boundary relative to the Heartroot valley is unstated.

markers.reading: The party is spread around the Heartroot grove after teleporting in; Kenzo stands beside the Heartroot and attunes to the valley.

evidence.quote: DM: Okay. So… That's when we'll trigger initiative. So, as you begin to get settled, everybody, you know, positioned themselves where they want. Kenzo is standing next to the Heartroot, in meditation, concentrating on attuning to this… essence of the valley.

DM: Everybody else is spread around, prepared for combat to begin. As you see in the distance, the Empress of Chaos, beginning to fly, curving around… As she's flying, you can see her now maybe 900, 1,000 feet away, racing towards you at incredible speed.

DM: About 45, 50 seconds after you landed teleporting. Kenzo attuned to the creature, as the Empress of Chaos is about 600 feet away, Kenzo begins to tell the… warn the Heartroot through your connection that danger is coming, and… yeah. So, so make a… just, just like roll, roll a D20, add your wisdom and your proficiency. So… plus 10, I think.

markers.reading: Withdraws from the aerial fight to the wooded low-cliff area, choosing distance from the Empress instead of remaining in Heartroot range.

DM: 160 feet away.
DM: I, I, I think Kenzo landed in the trees, I like…

markers.reading: Flies from the grove fight to join Kenzo, landing in front of him among the trees.

markers.note: Both endpoints refer to the same broad wooded pursuit area, not the same tactical position.

markers.reading: Teleports back toward the Heartroot to intercept the Cataclysm and maneuvers between it and the Heartroot in the grove battle area.

Delwath: Oh, you know what? Hold on, hold on. I'm also gonna move, sort of, around.
Delwath: Gotta be between it and the Heartroot as well.

markers.note: His first teleport intercept is about 80 feet from the Heartroot; the later interposition confirms the grove-area return, without claiming he stands atop the relic.

markers.reading: In silver-dragon form, pursues the Cataclysm back toward the grove and finally lands protectively over the Heartroot after destroying it.
